# awdns_domains (Data Source)

List all Authentic Web DNS domains, optionally narrowed by an in-provider `filter`. The upstream API has no query filter, so the filter is applied client-side over the full paginated listing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    awdns = {
      source = "AuthenticWeb/awdns"
    }
  }
}

variable "awdns_client_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "awdns_client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

provider "awdns" {
  client_id     = var.awdns_client_id
  client_secret = var.awdns_client_secret
}

# List every domain.
data "awdns_domains" "all" {}

# List only active (status 7) domains served by the "ns1" DNS provider. The
# filter is applied client-side; omit a field to leave that dimension open.
data "awdns_domains" "active_ns1" {
  filter = {
    status       = 7
    dns_provider = "ns1"
  }
}

output "all_fqdns" {
  value = [for d in data.awdns_domains.all.domains : d.fqdn]
}

output "active_ns1_count" {
  value = length(data.awdns_domains.active_ns1.domains)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Attributes) Optional client-side filter. Each field is ANDed; omit a field to leave that dimension unfiltered. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))

### Read-Only

- `domains` (Attributes List) The matched domains. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))

<a id="nestedatt--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Optional:

- `dns_provider` (String) Keep only domains served by this DNS provider.
- `status` (Number) Keep only domains with this upstream status code.


<a id="nestedatt--domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains`

Read-Only:

- `dns_provider` (String) DNS provider backing the zone.
- `fqdn` (String) Fully-qualified domain name.
- `id` (String) Numeric domain ID.
- `name` (String) Domain name as registered upstream.
- `nameserver_list` (List of String) Authoritative nameservers for the domain.
- `status` (Number) Upstream domain status code.
- `tld` (String) Top-level domain.
- `use_our_zone` (Boolean) Whether the domain uses an Authentic-Web-hosted zone.
